clues.it: Bruno era nella 11ª colonna e accanto a una cassa, ma non era accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 11th column and beside a crate, but was not beside a chair.

clues.it: Anna era nella 4ª colonna, accanto a un barile e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Anna was in the 4th column, beside a barrel and west of Dario.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 9ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Dario.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 9th column and in the same room as Dario.

clues.it: Carla era in una stanza diversa da Paolo e in Stiva.
clues.en: Carla was in a different room from Paolo and in the Hold.

clues.it: Dario era nella 6ª colonna e in Stiva, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Dario was in the 6th column and in the Hold, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Giada era accanto a una rete e a nord di Vito.
clues.en: Giada was beside a net and north of Vito.

clues.it: Luca era nella 5ª colonna e in Cambusa, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Luca was in the 5th column and in the Galley, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Paolo era accanto a uno scaffale, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Paolo was beside a shelf, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 2ª colonna e accanto a un salvagente.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 2nd column and beside a life ring.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a una pianta o a un salvagente e in Cabina.
clues.en: Nino was beside a plant or a life ring and in the Cabin.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 11ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 11th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 10ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 10th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Dario può stare solo nella 6ª colonna: escludendola, a Nino resta una sola casella: riga 11ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Dario can only be in the 6th column: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 11th, column 7th.

steps.it: Rosa può stare solo nella 2ª colonna: escludendola, a Giada resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Rosa can only be in the 2nd column: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 6th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 9ª riga.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 9th row.

steps.it: Carla può stare solo nella 4ª riga.
steps.en: Carla can only be in the 4th row.

steps.it: Carla non può stare nella 8ª colonna.
steps.en: Carla cannot be in the 8th column.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 accanto a una sedia» non torna senza Carla: deve stare in riga 4ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 beside a chair” cannot add up without Carla: they must be at row 4th, column 10th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 accanto a una sedia» non torna senza Paolo: deve stare in riga 9ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 beside a chair” cannot add up without Paolo: they must be at row 9th, column 1st.

steps.it: Vito può stare solo nella 8ª riga.
steps.en: Vito can only be in the 8th row.

steps.it: Escludendo la 4ª riga di Carla, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Ruling out Carla's 4th row leaves Dario a single square: row 5th, column 6th.

steps.it: Dario può stare solo nella 5ª riga: escludendola, a Fabio resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Dario can only be in the 5th row: ruling it out leaves Fabio a single square: row 3rd, column 9th.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 6ª riga: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 6th row: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 7th, column 5th.

steps.it: Carla può stare solo nella 10ª colonna: escludendola, a Vito resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Carla can only be in the 10th column: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 8th, column 8th.
